templates.html:
<button type="button" class="btn-secondary btn-secondary--{{size}}" style="--bg:{{bg}};border-radius:{{radius}}px"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>{{label}}</button>
<style>
.btn-secondary {
  font: 600 15px/1 system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding: 11px 20px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bg);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--bg);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.btn-secondary--lg { padding: 14px 26px; font-size: 16px; }
.btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(36,20,48,.08); }
.btn-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(36,20,48,.14); }
.btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
.btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }
</style>
templates.tailwind:
<button type="button" class="bg-transparent cursor-pointer font-semibold disabled:opacity-45 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-black/5 active:bg-black/10 btn-secondary-tw btn-secondary-tw--{{size}}" style="border:2px solid {{bg}};color:{{bg}};border-radius:{{radius}}px"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>{{label}}</button>
<style>
.btn-secondary-tw--md { padding: 11px 20px; font-size: 15px; }
.btn-secondary-tw--lg { padding: 14px 26px; font-size: 16px; }
.btn-secondary-tw--{{size}}:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
</style>
